title: The Lobby
setting: Three-fifty later, you're standing under a low awning. The door says LAKSHMI INN. The lobby is dim, the AC hums, the receptionist barely looks up from the register.

beats.beat: barely glances up from the register

choices.en: (Hand her your phone with the booking open)

beats.native: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ ಸಾರ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ booking ರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ problem ಇದೆ. Breakfast ಸೇರಿಸಿಲ್ಲ.
beats.translit: kṣamisi sār. nimma booking-ralli ondu saṇṇa problem ide. breakfast sērisilla.
beats.en: Sorry boss. There's a small problem with your booking. Breakfast isn't included.
beats.beat: as if she's apologising for the receipt printer

choices.native: ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. Booking ರಲ್ಲಿ included ಅಂತ ಇತ್ತು. ನೋಡಿ ಪ್ಲೀಸ್.
choices.translit: paravāgilla. booking-ralli included anta ittu. nōḍi please.
choices.en: It's okay. The booking said it was included. Please check.
That's not right. I paid for it.

beats.native: ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ ಸಾರ್. ನಾನು manager ಗೆ ಕೇಳ್ತೀನಿ.
beats.translit: ondu nimiṣa sār. nānu manager-ge kēḷtīni.
beats.en: One minute boss. I'll ask the manager.
beats.beat: picks up the desk phone with one hand, still smiling

beats.native: ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತು ಸಾರ್. Tomorrow breakfast ಕೊಡ್ತಾರೆ. Room three-oh-four. Wi-Fi password ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೆ.
beats.translit: sikkitu sār. tomorrow breakfast koḍtāre. room three-oh-four. Wi-Fi password illi ide.
beats.en: Sorted, boss. They'll give you breakfast tomorrow. Room three-oh-four. The Wi-Fi password is here.
beats.beat: slides the key card and a printed slip across the desk

beats.prompt: You take the key. You say:

beats.beat: the smile reaches her eyes this time
